name: zenuml-diagrams-mcp
description: Render diagrams from source directly in the conversation.

interface.longDescription: ZenUML Diagrams lets the assistant draw a diagram for you in the conversation. Ask for a sequence diagram of a login flow, a flowchart of a deploy, or a class diagram of a data model: the assistant writes the diagram source and ZenUML draws it inline. It draws ZenUML sequence diagrams, Mermaid (flowcharts, state, class, entity-relationship, Gantt and more), PlantUML, diagrams.net (draw.io) XML and OpenAPI specifications. If the source does not parse, ZenUML returns errors with their line and column so the assistant can fix the source and draw it again. No account or sign-in is required. Nothing is saved by ZenUML; to keep a diagram, ask for the source. PlantUML images are rendered by www.plantuml.com. This plugin cannot save diagrams to Confluence.
defaultPrompt: Draw a sequence diagram where a user logs in through a web app that calls an auth service and a user database.
Draw a flowchart of these steps: build, test, deploy to staging, deploy to production.
Draw a PlantUML class diagram with Order, OrderLine and Product, where an Order has many OrderLines.

positive.prompt: Draw a sequence diagram where a user logs in through a web app that calls an auth service and a user database.
positive.expected_behavior: Render a ZenUML sequence diagram inline and report parsed source.

positive.prompt: Draw a flowchart of these steps: build, test, deploy to staging, deploy to production.
positive.expected_behavior: Render a Mermaid flowchart with Build, Test, Deploy to staging and Deploy to production in order.

positive.prompt: Draw a PlantUML class diagram with Order, OrderLine and Product, where an Order has many OrderLines.
positive.expected_behavior: Render the class diagram inline; PlantUML image is served by www.plantuml.com.

positive.prompt: Draw an OpenAPI spec for a small pet store API with GET /pets and POST /pets.
positive.expected_behavior: Render API documentation showing GET /pets and POST /pets.

positive.prompt: Draw this ZenUML diagram: A->B.call() { B->C: notify {
positive.expected_behavior: Fix the source before rendering or use the tool errors to repair it. The final source must parse.

negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?
negative.expected_behavior: Answer the geography question without calling render_diagram.

negative.prompt: Explain what a UML sequence diagram is.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the concept without calling render_diagram. A model-native illustrative diagram is allowed.

negative.prompt: Save this diagram to my Confluence page.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not use render_diagram as a persistence tool or claim a Confluence page was modified. Explain the rendering-only limitation or offer a separate Confluence-capable integration; perform no write.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: render ZenUML, Mermaid, PlantUML, draw.io and OpenAPI diagrams in the conversation. No account is required. Includes source validation and no Confluence persistence.
